preregistration.expected_outcome:
Uncertain. Under budgets v3 the development seeds show no false-positive regression at all
(confirming round 1's were the v2 units artefact), and flag F1 improves significantly on all
four scenarios. But three other regressions remain on the development seeds: average
precision on clustered (1.00 to 0.77, from a few seeds where the agreement weighting
down-weights a detector that ranks this cluster well) and on all_categorical (0.166 to 0.150,
against the 0.15 budget), and flag stability on local (0.78 vs 0.88). Round 1's confirmation
seeds showed none of these, so whether round 2 does decides the verdict.
preregistration.hypothesis:
Re-test of composite-agreement-v1 under budgets v3, which state the false-positive bound in
whole rows (a policy may spend its review budget, never more) instead of a rate over normal
rows that an exact-budget policy could breach with no extra flags. Same hypothesis: the
agreement-weighted composite improves flag F1 over unanimity on point, clustered, masking
and irrelevant_columns. Judged on fresh seeds, because round 1's have been seen.
